frame.title: Deliveries
frame.signOutBody: Everything you recorded has been sent.
frame.signOutWaiting_one: 1 record is still on this phone. It stays here and is sent when a driver signs in again.
frame.signOutWaiting_other: {{count}} records are still on this phone. They stay here and are sent when a driver signs in again.

sync.storeError: This phone cannot keep your run. What you record may be lost if the page closes.
sync.blocked_one: Your session ended. 1 record waits on this phone and is sent once you sign in again.
sync.blocked_other: Your session ended. {{count}} records wait on this phone and are sent once you sign in again.
sync.noSignal_one: No signal. 1 record is kept on this phone and is sent when the signal returns.
sync.noSignal_other: No signal. {{count}} records are kept on this phone and are sent when the signal returns.

run.title: Today's run
run.denied: You cannot see a delivery run
run.error: Your run could not be loaded
run.errorOffline: There is no signal and this phone has not kept a run yet. Try again where there is signal.
run.kept: Not read again just now: this is your run as this phone kept it at {{when}}.
run.emptyBody: When the office puts deliveries on a run for you, they appear here.
run.cashDue: Cash to collect on this run, from the office:
run.stops: Stops in the order to visit

status.refused: Refused by the office: open the stop

stop.notFound: This stop is not on your run
stop.notFoundBody: It may belong to another run, or the office moved it.
stop.notKept: This phone could not keep that. Try again.
stop.partDelivery: Part delivered, or part refused? That cannot be recorded yet. Deliver all of it, or record it as not delivered with the reason, and tell the office what was kept.

record.waiting: Kept on this phone, waiting to send
record.rejectedNext: It stays on this phone. Tell the office, and quote what it says above.
record.cashDiffers: This is not the {{due}} to collect: it goes on the driver variance report.

proof.title: Delivered to {{name}}
proof.name: Who took it
proof.nameHint: The name of the person who received the delivery.
proof.nameMissing: Write the name of the person who took it.
proof.photoHint: The goods at the door, or the person holding them. It is kept on this phone until there is signal.
proof.photoNotKept: This phone could not keep the photo. Take it again.
proof.cashHint: Count it. {{due}} is to collect; write what you were actually given.
proof.cashMissing: Write the cash you were given, even if it is 0.
proof.confirmBody: Delivered to {{name}}, with the photograph you took.
proof.consequence: It is kept on this phone and sent when there is signal. It cannot be changed here afterwards.
proof.differs: What you received is not what was to collect. Record exactly what you were given: it goes on the driver variance report.
proof.notKept: This phone could not keep the record. Try again.
proof.already: This stop already has a record on this phone.

failure.title: Not delivered to {{name}}
failure.noReasons: The reasons have not reached this phone yet. Open the run where there is signal first.
failure.reasonMissing: Choose why it was not delivered.
failure.reattempt: Keep them on the van to try again
failure.nextMissing: Choose what happens to the goods.
failure.reattemptBody: The office plans another attempt. It is kept on this phone and sent when there is signal.
failure.returnBody: The goods come back to stock. It is kept on this phone and sent when there is signal.
failure.notKept: This phone could not keep the record. Try again.

cash.title: Cash I carry
cash.notRead: The office's figure has not reached this phone yet.
cash.carrying: Cash you carry, from the office:
cash.handIn: Hand all of it in at a till shift
cash.handInBody: At the end of your run, give the cash to a cashier at the till. They count it into their shift. It is never written down as loose cash.
cash.unsentBody: Recorded on this phone and not in the office's figure until it is sent.
